$comment: Canonical manifest of OCI distroless image targets published to GHCR. This is the SINGLE source of truth for the GitHub Actions build/manifest matrices, `just validate`, `just sbom`, and the pull-request build gate (`just changed-targets`). Adding a package requires exactly one entry in `oci_images` plus the BST element at elements/oci/<name>.bst and its path ownership in `image_paths` -- no edits to any matrix loop or case list.
$comment_image_paths: Path prefixes each OCI image owns. `just changed-targets` matches changed files against these to decide which images a pull request must actually build and verify, so a one-image change costs one build instead of many. A prefix ending in '/' matches everything under that directory; anything else matches that exact path.
$comment_archs: Host architectures each image is built and published for (the per-architecture matrix in the workflows). The official archlinux:base image is amd64-only, so 'arch' is not built on the aarch64 leg.
$comment_shared_paths: Changes here can affect every target (the FSDK junction, the shared slim recipe, project-wide options, the build tooling itself), so these select the canary image below: a real end-to-end build and `just verify` of the image every other image is carved from.
